name: Java Edition 26.3

sources.title: Java Edition 26.3 server jar data (recipe, villager_trade, cooking fuel providers)

notes: Recipes, villager trades and fuel burn times are read from the data files of the official 26.3 server jar and cross-checked with the Minecraft Wiki. Only the recipes that farm chains need, not the whole recipe book. Where the game accepts several items (any planks, any log, sand or red sand) one representative item is listed. Cooking: a furnace takes 10 s per item, a blast furnace or smoker 5 s and burns fuel twice as fast, so fuel per item is the same. Trades are the default trades (not the trade rebalance experiment); a villager restocks up to twice per Minecraft day (20 minutes) when it can reach its job site.
